title.narrative: Advanced Knowledge and Skills for Sustainable Growth Project

description.narrative: The proposed project will support advanced skills and knowledge for sustainable economic growth in Indonesia by upgrading three public universities in Sumatra and one public university in Bandung, West Java, as the first phase of higher-education reform. The project will support the construction and/or upgrading of new facilities that incorporate green-building and climate-proofing design features. The project will strengthen staff capacity at the universities and support demand-driven quality education and research aligned with local economic priorities. It will integrate new technologies in teaching programs, strengthen technical and vocational teacher education, and help the government develop a medium-term higher-education investment plan.
